shape.situation_pattern: A public repo could let a partner infer a hidden swarm, a deniable comm layer, or the doctrine.
shape.decision: Keep specialized tools, sovereign state, and doctrine private; publish only the mycelial republic and generic first-step patterns.
shape.reasoning_physics: Privacy is not hiding the tool—it is leaving out what does not transfer so the deeper truth survives. If any reader could reconstruct the factory, it stays in.
